##### Project general facts

Hawa Residence by Al Marwan Developments is a contemporary low-rise residential community set on a generous plot within a calm suburban neighbourhood. The building rises from a ground floor to four residential floors, with smooth, flowing lines, a modern design and natural colours. Large windows bring in daylight and open views. The project offers studios and one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments, with the larger homes including a maid's room, together with covered parking for residents.

Communal life is centred on three expansive landscaped courtyards with manicured gardens and green areas. Residents can enjoy a large swimming pool, a children's play area and a zen garden for rest and meditation. A retail promenade with shops, cafes and restaurants adds everyday convenience and a lively atmosphere, while covered parking, landscaped walkways and shaded seating areas complete the shared spaces for residents and their guests.

Interiors combine stylish design with high-quality finishes and practical layouts. Living and dining areas open onto private balconies, and selected homes feature terraces. Kitchens are modern and functional, bathrooms are elegant, and bedrooms include built-in wardrobes for ample storage. Larger apartments add a powder room and a maid's room with its own bathroom. Homes are delivered with fitted kitchens, leaving furniture to the owner's own taste.

##### Location description and benefits

Tilal City is a large master-planned community in Sharjah, designed around residential neighbourhoods, schools, mosques, retail and green spaces. It sits close to the border with Dubai and offers a calmer suburban setting with modern infrastructure. The Masaar community, with its cycling and jogging track, Victoria International School of Sharjah and the Sharjah Mosque are all within walking distance or a short drive, giving families everyday essentials close to home.

Sharjah International Airport, University City, Aljada and the House of Wisdom are a short drive away, as are the Sharjah Equestrian and Racing Club and government buildings. Major highways connect residents with Dubai and Dubai International Airport, making daily commuting straightforward. Supermarkets, clinics and community retail are spread across the surrounding neighbourhoods, and the airport makes regional travel easy.

Sharjah offers freehold ownership to all nationalities in designated areas, including Tilal City. Accessible entry points compared with Dubai, combined with proximity to the Dubai border, support consistent demand from families and professionals working in both emirates. Steady growth of neighbouring master communities such as Aljada strengthens the long-term appeal of the area for both end users and investors focused on rental income.
